# Slumpgenerator

> A simple but powerful site with an optimized, versatile collection of online random generators.

## Pages

- [Slumpgenerator](https://slumpgenerator.com): With Slumpgenerator, you can randomize numbers, cities, and groups. You can also flip a coin or randomly generate a Yes or No. Slumpgenerator is continuously updated with values and content to randomize.
- [Changelog](https://slumpgenerator.com/changelog): Follow the development of Slumpgenerator and find out when new features are released.
- [About](https://slumpgenerator.com/about): Slumpgenerator was launched on May 24, 2020, with the goal of becoming one of the most flexible random generators online.
- [Articles](https://slumpgenerator.com/articles)
- [Privacy Policy](https://slumpgenerator.com/privacy-policy): This privacy policy explains how we handle data and cookies when you use the website slumpgenerator.com.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://slumpgenerator.com/accessibility): Slumpgenerator strives to be accessible to as many users as possible. Here we describe how the website meets accessibility requirements, any known issues, and how you can report problems to us.
- [Leave feedback](https://slumpgenerator.com/feedback): Thank you for leaving feedback! All your answers are valuable and help make Slumpgenerator the best website for randomizing.

## Random generators

- [Dice roller](https://slumpgenerator.com/dice-roller): Here you can roll dice directly in your browser – quickly, smoothly, and without any hassle. A digital dice roll is just as useful for game night as it is when traveling, in the classroom, or whenever you need to make a random decision.
- [Random Name Picker](https://slumpgenerator.com/random-name-picker): With Slumpgenerator's Random Name Picker, you can randomize names and draw lots from a list. Perfect for determining order or picking a winner.
- [Random Number Generator](https://slumpgenerator.com/random-number-generator): Generate a random number between any two values using this random number generator.
- [Random Team Generator](https://slumpgenerator.com/random-team-generator): Enter all participants and randomize groups or draw teams with Slumpgenerator's Random Team Generator.
- [List Randomizer](https://slumpgenerator.com/list-randomizer): The List Randomizer lets you take any list of items and turn it into a new random order. This random list generator is useful for draws, scheduling, games, or whenever you want chance to decide the sequence.
- [Yes or No](https://slumpgenerator.com/yes-or-no): When faced with tough decisions, it can sometimes be tempting to leave fate to chance, but modern technology has given us Yes and No randomizers that help you make tough choices.
- [Flip a coin](https://slumpgenerator.com/flip-a-coin): Don't have any coins to flip? Slumpgenerator understands you. In today's digital society, you flip coins online. So take the opportunity to flip as many coins as you want – it doesn't cost extra.
- [Random Letter Generator](https://slumpgenerator.com/random-letter-generator): With this random letter generator, you can easily get a random letter from the alphabet. Click the button to randomize A–Z.
- [Random Image](https://slumpgenerator.com/random-image): Get a random image from the Cupcake image service, which provides images you can use freely for any purpose.
- [UUID Generator](https://slumpgenerator.com/uuid-generator): Quickly and easily generate random UUIDs (universally unique identifiers) with this UUID generator.
- [Nano ID Generator](https://slumpgenerator.com/nano-id-generator): Quickly and easily generate random Nano IDs with this Nano ID generator.
- [Random Pokémon™ Generator](https://slumpgenerator.com/random-pokemon-generator): Here you can explore all Pokémon™ and choose one or more generations to control which Pokémon™ you can randomize.
